description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for handling file uploads and serving a simple HTML form for uploading multiple files.

methods.name: create_files( files: Annotated[list[bytes], File(description="Multiple files as bytes")], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /files/ for uploading multiple files as byte data.
parameters: files: Annotated[list[bytes], File(description='Multiple files as bytes')]

methods.name: create_upload_files( files: Annotated[ list[UploadFile], File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile") ], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /uploadfiles/ for uploading multiple files as UploadFile objects.
parameters: files: Annotated[list[UploadFile], File(description='Multiple files as UploadFile')]

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to / and returns an HTML page with upload forms.

ctags.name: create_files
ctags.signature: ( files: Annotated[list[bytes], File(description="Multiple files as bytes")], )

ctags.name: create_upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: Annotated[ list[UploadFile], File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile") ], )
